title: You get what you pay for. Cheapie holder, just okay grinders
text:
You get what you pay for. Cheapie holder, just okay grinders. I recently got some different peppercorns and needed some new grinders. So I decided to try this set.

The grinders themselves are pretty small. The grinder mechanism does not look super sturdy, so I hope it surprises me.

But the worst part is the holder. Either I received a corroded holder, or these have a really bad finish on them. It feels like there is salt on a lot of it, but there isn't - it is the bad finish. I tried cleaning it, in case something got on it at the warehouse. Nope - just a bad finish. Maybe some day I will sand it down (yes, so rough that it needs sanding) and just paint it. But I am not using the holder as is.
